title: Dryer House Tariff for Grain Storage and Conditioning Agreements
content:
The dryer at each licensed facility runs grain held under Grain Storage and Conditioning Agreements down to the moisture the programme targets, and the charge, the floor under it, the smallest billable quantity of moisture and the shrink taken for each point are all posted by programme.

## What the tariff fixes

1. The rate charged for each moisture point removed from each bushel.
2. The smallest number of points that will be billed on any one drying pass, in percentage points.
3. The moisture the dryer runs the grain down to, as a percentage.
4. The handling shrink taken for each point removed, over and above water loss, as a percentage for each point.
5. The floor under the drying charge for any one pass.

## Posted dryer house tariff

| Programme | Rate for each point on each bushel (USD) | Smallest billable points | Target moisture (percent) | Handling shrink for each point (percent) | Pass minimum (USD) |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Open Storage Account | 0.0450 | 0.5 | 15.0 | 0.50 | 15.00 |
| Grain Bank Deposit Account | 0.0450 | 0.5 | 15.0 | 0.50 | 15.00 |
| Commercial Warehouse Receipt Storage | 0.0450 | 0.5 | 14.5 | 0.50 | 20.00 |
| Seasonal Paid-Up Storage Agreement | 0.0450 | 0.5 | 14.5 | 0.50 | 20.00 |
| Conditioned Reserve Storage Agreement | 0.0400 | 0.5 | 14.0 | 0.40 | 25.00 |
| Identity Preserved Segregated Storage | 0.0500 | 0.5 | 13.5 | 0.40 | 35.00 |

## Notes for the scale house

The smallest billable quantity of moisture is 0.5 of a point on every programme in the catalogue, so a pass that takes out less than that is still billed as though half a point had come off.

The target moisture falls as the catalogue rises: 15.0 percent on the two lowest programmes, 14.5 percent on the two in the middle, 14.0 percent on the Conditioned Reserve Storage Agreement and 13.5 percent on the Identity Preserved Segregated Storage.

The handling shrink for each point is 0.50 percent on the four lower programmes and 0.40 percent on the two highest.

## Boundary illustration, on hypothetical readings

Grain read in at 15.2 percent on an Open Storage Account stands two tenths of a point above that programme's target of 15.0 percent; two tenths being under the smallest billable quantity of 0.5, the pass is billed on half a point. The same grain on an Identity Preserved Segregated Storage stands 1.7 points above that programme's target of 13.5 percent, which is above the smallest billable quantity, so the pass is billed on the 1.7 points actually taken out.
